clodex.title: Your characters. More dimensions.
clodex.subtitle: Text, images, video and voice with CLODEx.
clodex.keyHelp: Media key stays in this tab's memory, not in chat exports or extension settings. Re-enter it after a reload. Other installed extensions can access browser memory.
clodex.quotaHelp: This is the API key's allowance, not necessarily the account wallet. An unlimited key does not mean free generation or an unlimited wallet.
clodex.proxyHelp: For prices and exchange rates only. Requires enableCorsProxy: true in SillyTavern config.yaml and a server restart. Do not expose the server publicly. The proxy receives no CLODEx key from this extension.
clodex.activateHelp: Sets Custom OpenAI to CLODEx and saves this key in SillyTavern's server-side Secrets store. Existing connections are not changed until you click.
clodex.priceHelp: Public reference prices in USD; your key's group, options, long context and promotions can change the final bill. Cache read price is shown only when returned by the API.
clodex.parametersHelp: Leave optional fields blank for provider defaults. Accepted sizes, duration, image-to-video support and voices vary by model.
clodex.quietPrompt: Compose scene prompts with the active text model (additional API usage)
clodex.contextHelp: Scene generation sends character description, scenario and up to four recent messages to CLODEx. Quiet prompts also use SillyTavern's configured text context/provider.
clodex.autoImages: Auto-illustrate new replies (paid; at most once per minute)
clodex.transcribeHelp: Inserts recognized text into the composer; never sends it automatically. No background microphone recording.
clodex.toolHelp: Opt-in. Requires a text model and SillyTavern connection with tool calling enabled. Every tool generation asks for confirmation, even if manual confirmations are disabled.
clodex.promoHelp: No hard-coded free-video promises. CLODEx applies any eligible promotion server-side.
clodex.connected: Connected. {count} models available to this key.
clodex.metadataUnavailable: Prices/exchange rate unavailable (CORS or network). Enable the public-metadata proxy above, or wait for CLODEx CORS support. Generation can still work.
clodex.forgotten: Tab key removed. A key previously saved to Custom OpenAI remains in SillyTavern Secrets; remove it there if needed.
clodex.emptyCatalog: Connect to load models. No hard-coded model list.
clodex.paidConfirm: Generate {kind} with {model}? This can incur charges. Scene prompt composition may also use the text API.
clodex.autoConfirm: Enable paid automatic images after new character replies? Maximum one per minute, no automatic retries. Character/chat context will be sent to the configured providers.
clodex.activateConfirm: Switch Custom OpenAI to CLODEx and store this key in SillyTavern Secrets?
clodex.activated: Custom OpenAI configured for {model}; SillyTavern is checking the connection.
clodex.transcribed: Transcription inserted into the composer (not sent).
clodex.stopped: Stopped locally. Any submitted server job may continue and incur charges.
clodex.uncertain: Submission/delivery is uncertain. Check CLODEx history before generating again; do not blindly retry.
clodex.resumeHint: Task {id}. Resume downloads/polling only; it does not create a second video.
